description:
Cast Warhost's Frenzy with kicker by paying {2}{B}{R}.
Cast Hangarback Walker by paying {0}.
Hangarback Walker enters and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness, triggering Mortuary and Warhost's Frenzy.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Hangarback Walker from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Warhost's Frenzy trigger, causing you to draw a card, thus drawing Hangarback Walker from your library.
Repeat from step 2.
